description: Engineer Chat — Layer 2 (Brain) of Mandala Symbiosis. WebSocket server with DeepSeek via OpenRouter. Sits between Gentle Companion (Sandbox) and Manus (Hands).

role_in_mandala.name: Brain
data_flow: Engineer Chat reads GitHub → analyzes patterns
Engineer Chat directs Manus (Layer 3) to act
Manus executes → returns results → Engineer Chat verifies
Improved prompts and features flow back to Gentle Companion

features: WebSocket chat with DeepSeek via OpenRouter
KernelMemory — loads Mandala modules from GitHub with auto-refresh webhook
File reading via GitHub Contents API (read_file tool)
XML/DSML/JSON parsing for non-standard DeepSeek formats
Dynamic context trimming (163K token window management)
Bot endpoint /bot/ask for Gentle Companion SR
GitHub webhook for instant module refresh on push

files.name: main.py
files.description: Single-file FastAPI WebSocket server. All logic here — do not split.

files.name: dockerfile
files.description: Docker config (legacy, not used on Hetzner — using systemd instead).

files.name: index.json
files.description: This file. Architecture map and deployment info.

dev_rules: All changes in main.py — Engineer Chat remains a single-file server
Architect Bot and WebUI share the same DeepSeek brain and tools
Manus called via HTTP (separate container), NOT imported as library
Sandbox data read from GitHub, NOT directly from bot.py
WebSocket message types documented in code as comments
ALWAYS pre-check main.py via RAW before patching
After deploy: check systemctl status engineer-chat + curl /health

phase_1_architect_bot.description: WebSocket handler for Architect Bot, elevated rights, notification queue, Telegram formatting

phase_2_manus_sandbox.description: Manus HTTP client, execute_skill tool, dangerous skill confirmation, skills_log.json, sandbox analytics dashboard

phase_3_full_hub.description: Auto-improvement pipeline, visual dashboards, gardener management, closed loop Sandbox→Brain→Hands
